_why: Read by the clean-code pre-commit hook (~/.config/git/hooks).
This branch exists to preserve the Rust backend unchanged, not to
maintain it. Its 15,800 lines predate the hook and the whole value of
the commit is that they are byte-for-byte what passed 374 tests --
reformatting them to satisfy a linter would destroy the only claim the
branch makes. Same category as the vendor/ directories the hook's own
defaults exclude: present, not worked on.
The ab-* comparison scripts go with it; they exist only to run it.
Nothing on main is excluded, and main does not carry this file.
